verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents uploading fine-tuned models from S3, tracking versions and deploying them to a dedicated endpoint, alongside standard model variants, so custom weights can be uploaded and served. The capability is limited to dedicated (private, provisioned) endpoints rather than the public self-serve tier. missing for 10: explicit LoRA adapter support, documented supported architectures/weight formats, availability outside dedicated endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track multiple versions, and deploy them to your [dedicated endpoint](/dedicated/overview).
Deploy your custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants.
A dedicated endpoint is a private, provisioned instance of the Cerebras Inference service reserved exclusively for your organization.
